segments.expected: "A quarter," said Noa, at the mast. "At both. Three lines, two gaps, nothing across either." He looked up. His face was very pink. "That's clean. It's all clean."
segments.transcript: A quarter, said Noah at the mast, at both. Three lines, two gaps, nothing across either. He looked up. His face was very pink. That's clean. It's all clean.

segments.expected: "I'd like it known," he said, "that I'll not be doing that with my eyes shut in front of a Blaze."
segments.transcript: I'd like it known, he said, that I'll not be doing that with my eyes shut in front of a blaze.

segments.expected: "It's cold. The wax is stiff. That's why you've a little finger." Pru showed her. She did it slowly, as she had done it for Pike by a stove, and the little finger came across the first turn from the far side and held it while the long end went under, and nothing slackened. "There. It's a second pin. You'll not get it today. I didn't get it for a fortnight, and I'd been tying since I was twelve."

segments.expected: "Planted," said Perrin, with his eyes shut.
segments.transcript: Planted, said Perrin, with his eyes shut.

segments.expected: "You dropped your count to haul. You said so, aloud, so that nobody would think they had it. Then you put a stance at your Hold's back when she asked for one. Then your catcher said a word and you shut it and stepped off without asking why." Coombe's voice did not change by a hair. "Then you told your four that nobody stands together, before any of them could think of it for themselves. And you tied a bag like a man holding a cigarette." She paused. "Your catcher said nobody. Who taught you to open and shut on it?"

Then you told your four that nobody stands together, before any of them could think of it for themselves. And you tied a bag like a man holding a cigarette. She paused. Your catcher said nobody. Who taught you to open and shut on it?

segments.expected: They did it four times. On the third, Perrin opened early, before the end of the word, and his still door was there and waiting and empty for half a count before Kiva came down into it, and Noa said clean and then said early, and Perrin said that he would rather be early than late, and Coombe said nothing. On the fourth it was a quarter at both.
